tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store a fact, preference, or piece of context about the user or their work so it can be recalled in future conversations. Call this whenever the user shares something worth keeping.

content.description: The memory to store, as a self-contained statement.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Retrieve stored memories relevant to a query. Use this at the start of a task or whenever earlier context, preferences, or decisions might help.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: List the most recent stored memories, newest first.

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Replace the content of an existing memory by id.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete a stored memory by id.

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Return how many memories are stored and when the last one was added.

tools.name: brave_web_search
tools.description: Performs a web search using the Brave Search API, ideal for general queries, news, articles, and online content. Use this for broad information gathering, recent events, or when you need diverse web sources. Supports pagination and freshness controls.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetches a URL from the internet and extracts its contents as markdown. Use this to read a web page the user links or a search result.

tools.name: brave_news_search
tools.description: Searches news articles using the Brave News Search API. Use for current events, breaking news, and recent developments.

tools.name: brave_local_search
tools.description: Searches for local businesses and places using Brave's Local Search API. Best for queries related to physical locations, businesses, restaurants, services.

tools.name: brave_image_search
tools.description: Searches for images using the Brave Image Search API.

tools.name: brave_summarizer
tools.description: Returns an AI-generated summary of web search results for a query.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a team. Provide a title and optionally a description in markdown, a priority (0 none, 1 urgent, 2 high, 3 medium, 4 low), labels, a project, and an assignee.

tools.name: list_my_issues
tools.description: List issues assigned to the current user, ordered by priority. Filter by state to see what is in progress or still todo.

tools.name: assign_issue
tools.description: Assign an issue to a user, or to yourself with "me". Assigning yourself an issue moves it to In Progress.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Retrieve an issue by identifier, with its description, state, assignee, labels, and comments.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search issues by text across titles and descriptions, with optional filters for team, state, label, and assignee.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an existing issue's title, description, priority, labels, project, or state.

tools.name: add_issue_comment
tools.description: Add a markdown comment to an issue.

tools.name: set_issue_state
tools.description: Move an issue to a workflow state such as Todo, In Progress, In Review, Done, or Canceled.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects in the workspace with their lead, status, and target date.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List the teams in the workspace with their keys.

tools.name: list_cycles
tools.description: List the current and upcoming cycles for a team.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Full-text search across all notes in the vault. Returns matching note paths with the surrounding context.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a new markdown note in the vault. Use this to write down ideas, meeting notes, decisions, or anything the user wants to keep.

path.description: Path relative to the vault root, ending in .md

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read the full content of a note by path.

tools.name: append_to_note
tools.description: Append markdown to the end of an existing note.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List notes in a folder of the vault.

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Replace the content of a note.

tools.name: get_daily_note
tools.description: Open today's daily note, creating it from the template if it does not exist.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List every tag used in the vault with its note count.

tools.name: get_backlinks
tools.description: List the notes that link to a given note.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Move a note to the vault's trash.

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Add a task to the user's task list, with an optional due date, priority, and project.

due_string.description: Natural language due date, such as "tomorrow 9am"

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List open tasks, optionally filtered by project or a filter query such as "today | overdue".

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task as done.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Change a task's content, due date, or priority.

tools.name: list_task_projects
tools.description: List the user's task projects.

tools.name: read_text_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system as text. Handles various text encodings and provides detailed error messages if the file cannot be read. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files without warning. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Make line-based edits to a text file. Each edit replaces exact line sequences with new content. Returns a git-style diff showing the changes made. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern. Searches through all subdirectories from the starting path. Only searches within allowed directories.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path. Results clearly distinguish between files and directories with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes.

tools.name: read_multiple_files
tools.description: Read the contents of multiple files simultaneously. More efficient than reading files one by one when you need to analyze or compare multiple files.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a new directory or ensure a directory exists. Can create multiple nested directories in one operation.

tools.name: directory_tree
tools.description: Get a recursive tree view of files and directories as a JSON structure.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename files and directories. Fails if the destination exists.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Retrieve detailed metadata about a file or directory: size, creation time, last modified time, permissions, and type.

tools.name: list_allowed_directories
tools.description: Returns the list of directories that this server is allowed to access.

tools.name: create_entities
tools.description: Create multiple new entities in the knowledge graph, each with a name, an entity type, and a list of observations.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Search for nodes in the knowledge graph based on a query. Matches entity names, types, and observation content.

tools.name: add_observations
tools.description: Add new observations to existing entities in the knowledge graph.

tools.name: create_relations
tools.description: Create multiple new relations between entities in the knowledge graph. Relations should be in active voice.

tools.name: open_nodes
tools.description: Open specific nodes in the knowledge graph by their names.

tools.name: read_graph
tools.description: Read the entire knowledge graph.

tools.name: delete_entities
tools.description: Delete multiple entities and their associated relations from the knowledge graph.

tools.name: delete_observations
tools.description: Delete specific observations from entities in the knowledge graph.

tools.name: delete_relations
tools.description: Delete multiple relations from the knowledge graph.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search for code across GitHub repositories using GitHub's code search syntax.

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Get the contents of a file or directory from a GitHub repository.

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.description: Create a new pull request in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: List and filter repository pull requests.

tools.name: get_pull_request
tools.description: Get details of a specific pull request, including its merge state.

tools.name: search_repositories
tools.description: Search for GitHub repositories.

tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: Get a list of commits of a branch in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Create a new branch in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: create_or_update_file
tools.description: Create or update a single file in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: merge_pull_request
tools.description: Merge a pull request in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a new message to a Slack channel.

tools.name: slack_search_messages
tools.description: Search messages across the Slack workspace the user can see.

tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: List public channels in the workspace with pagination.

tools.name: slack_reply_to_thread
tools.description: Reply to a specific message thread in Slack.

tools.name: slack_get_channel_history
tools.description: Get recent messages from a channel.

tools.name: slack_get_thread_replies
tools.description: Get all replies in a message thread.

tools.name: slack_add_reaction
tools.description: Add a reaction emoji to a message.

tools.name: slack_get_users
tools.description: Get a list of all users in the workspace with their basic profile information.

tools.name: slack_get_user_profile
tools.description: Get detailed profile information for a specific user.

tools.name: notion_search
tools.description: Search pages and databases in the connected Notion workspace by title and content. Use this to find documents, wikis, and meeting notes the team has written.

tools.name: notion_create_page
tools.description: Create a new Notion page under a parent page or database, with markdown content.

tools.name: notion_fetch_page
tools.description: Retrieve a Notion page or database by URL or id, as markdown.

tools.name: notion_update_page
tools.description: Update a Notion page's properties or replace its content.

tools.name: notion_append_blocks
tools.description: Append markdown blocks to the end of a Notion page.

tools.name: notion_query_database
tools.description: Query a Notion database with filters and sorts.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List events on the user's calendar in a time range.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event with a title, start and end time, attendees, and an optional description.

tools.name: find_free_time
tools.description: Find free slots across one or more calendars within a time range.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Change an existing event's time, title, attendees, or description.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event.

tools.name: respond_to_event
tools.description: Accept, decline, or tentatively accept an event invitation.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List the calendars the user can see.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query against the connected database and return the rows.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List the tables in a schema.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Show a table's columns, types, and constraints.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List the schemas in the connected database.

tools.name: explain_query
tools.description: Return the query plan for a SQL statement without running it.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List the databases on the connected server.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Capture an accessibility snapshot of the current page. This is better than a screenshot for deciding what to click.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Perform a click on a web page element.

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into an editable element.

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression on the page or an element.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a key on the keyboard.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear, or a specified time to pass.

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select an option in a dropdown.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close the page.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Shows the working tree status.

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Shows the commit logs.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Shows differences between branches or commits.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Records changes to the repository.

tools.name: git_add
tools.description: Adds file contents to the staging area.

tools.name: git_diff_unstaged
tools.description: Shows changes in the working directory that are not yet staged.

tools.name: git_diff_staged
tools.description: Shows changes that are staged for commit.

tools.name: git_create_branch
tools.description: Creates a new branch from an optional base branch.

tools.name: git_checkout
tools.description: Switches branches.

tools.name: git_show
tools.description: Shows the contents of a commit.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search the user's mailbox with Gmail search syntax and return matching threads.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email to one or more recipients.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read a single email message by id.

tools.name: draft_email
tools.description: Create a draft email without sending it.

tools.name: label_email
tools.description: Add or remove labels on a message.

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Get the current time in a specific IANA timezone.

tools.name: sequentialthinking
tools.description: A detailed tool for dynamic and reflective problem-solving through thoughts. Each thought can build on, question, or revise previous insights as understanding deepens.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert a time between timezones.
